the behavioral and neural mechanisms underlying the processing of non-rewarded events in experimental animals can be assessed using innovative procedures that leverage the power of probabilistic feedback.

the development of behavioral tests for the assessment of non-rewarded responding, and the mechanisms underlying the performance of such tasks.
understanding the mechanisms underlying non-rewarded responding, and the translational implications of such research for understanding the pathophysiology of neuropsychiatric disease.
the development and application of behavioral tests that assess the processing of unreinforced responses in experimental animals, and the mechanisms underlying the performance of such tasks.
